from pathlib import Path
import itertools

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row) - {bg}:
        pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            groups={}
            for r,c in pts:
                key = (r-c if dr==dc else r+c)
                groups.setdefault(key,[]).append((r,c))
            for group in groups.values():
                if len(group)<2: continue
                # project along the chosen positive direction, extend beyond both ends
                group.sort(key=lambda p: p[0])
                for start, step in ((group[0],(-dr,-dc)), (group[-1],(dr,dc))):
                    r,c=start[0]+step[0],start[1]+step[1]
                    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and out[r][c]==bg:
                        out[r][c]=color
                        r+=step[0]; c+=step[1]
    return out

O=transform(G)
